run_generate_agent_list: run the script to generate README docs for all Parlai agents into agent_refs directory
run_write_all_agents: run write_all_agents to generate markdown docs for each Parlai agent module
run_prepare_agent_readme: run prepare_agent_readme to load an agent README and append its CLI argument options
run_make_argparse_table: run _make_argparse_table to build a reStructuredText table of CLI args for an agent class
review_make_argparse_table: review _make_argparse_table to understand how it extracts and formats ParlaiParser argument groups into markdown tables
